changes: Shared aggregate task budget enforcement now rejects an aborted signal.
Source and metadata helpers check before and after asynchronous work; returned owned metadata releases if post-read admission/cancellation validation fails.
Work-unit planning accepts query budget/clock options and checks before planning, per range and at chunk flush.

edge_cases: already-aborted metadata-backed plan before nonexistent file access

limits: Synchronous loops cannot observe asynchronously delivered cancellation until control returns to the event loop.
External operations still must settle or implement cancellation; this does not forcibly terminate an arbitrary never-settling adapter.
remaining: Broader cancellation/fairness/legacy-spill lifecycle audit and full acceptance remain open.
